## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes (if any). Include relevant motivation and context.

Closes #(issue)

## Type of change
- Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- Documentation update
- Policy / risk-classification change

## How has this been tested?
Describe the tests you ran and how to reproduce them. List any relevant details for your test configuration.

## Checklist
- I have read the CONTRIBUTING guide
- My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- I have performed a self-review of my own code
- I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- New and existing unit tests pass locally (`pytest`)
- I have updated documentation where relevant
- Any consequential or risky actions introduced are covered by policy checks and audit logging
